patch.value:
SYMPTOM: The GraphQL query used `first: $limit` with NO pageInfo/endCursor and no follow loop. Linear caps `first` at 250 per page, so any sync of a team with >250 issues (or --limit > 250) silently returned at most ~250 and DROPPED the rest with no error.

ROOT CAUSE: single-page query; ISSUES_QUERY had no pageInfo block and syncLinearIssues made exactly one request.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed truncation at one page; expected all issues up to limit.

FIX: query now takes ($first, $after) and returns pageInfo{hasNextPage,endCursor}; new fetchAllLinearIssues() loops following endCursor, page size capped at LINEAR_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=250, stops at limit. Verified via stubbed 510-issue dataset: limit=510 fetched all 510 across 3 pages (250+250+10).
